questions.stem: A committee is drawn from 40 people, and 25% of them are women. How many women are there?
n people each shake hands once with every other person, giving n(n − 1)/2 = 15 handshakes. What positive value of n solves this?
questions.explain: The equation is n² − n − 30 = 0, which factors as (n − 6)(n + 5) = 0. The positive root is 6.
When dividing powers of the same base, subtract the exponents: 2³ = 8.

questions.stem: A menu has 3 starters and 4 main courses. How many different meals of one starter and one main are possible?

questions.explain: 5! / 3! = (5 × 4 × 3!) / 3! = 5 × 4 = 20. Cancel instead of multiplying everything out.
